title: A weakly solvating solvent-based quasi-solid electrolyte for sodium metal batteries
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,8838-8848
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE02153G, Paper
Open Access

Ho Mei Law, Zilong Wang, Shengjun Xu, Longyun Shen, Baptiste Py, Yuhao Wang, Renée Siegel, Jürgen Senker, Qingsong Wang, Francesco Ciucci
A novel weakly solvating solvent-based quasi-solid electrolyte (WS-QSE) using ring ethers for sodium batteries achieves superior cycling performance through a designed anion-dominated sodium ion solvation structure.
